def bonferroni_holm(p_values, alpha=0.05):
    """Bonferroni-Holm step-down procedure"""
    k = len(p_values)
    # Sort p-values with original indices
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(p_values)
    sorted_p = np.array(p_values)[sorted_indices]
    
    corrected_p = np.zeros(k)
    significant = np.zeros(k, dtype=bool)
    
    for i in range(k):
        threshold = alpha / (k - i)
        corrected_p[sorted_indices[i]] = min(sorted_p[i] * (k - i), 1.0)
        if sorted_p[i] <= threshold:
            significant[sorted_indices[i]] = True
